name: Horse mackerel
description: Cape horse mackerel (Trachurus trachurus capensis), a deep-bodied schooling carangid. Life-stage group of the source's juvenile (under 2 years) and adult (2 years and older) compartments: juveniles eat zooplankton while adults turn to fish and squid, so the two stanzas were measured apart but are pooled here to fit the 25-node ceiling.
